name: Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup
desc: Lemony chicken broth with shredded chicken, orzo, peas, and fresh herbs.

source.title: Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup
source.evidence: All ingredients match the site (8 cups broth, 1.5 cups orzo, 1/2 cup peas, rosemary, thyme and sage); supplies the herb amounts. Parsley amount is judgment (the page gives none).

ingredients.raw: 2 small boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 7 oz each)
Fine sea salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook, stirring, until the onion is translucent, 3-4 min.
Add the carrots and celery and cook until the colors brighten, about 5 min.

Add the chicken breasts, pour in the broth, and add the rosemary, thyme, and sage (loose, or tied in cheesecloth so they lift out together). Bring to a boil, then cover, reduce to low, and simmer until the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F, 10-12 min.

Lift the chicken onto a cutting board. Add the orzo to the pot and simmer uncovered, stirring now and then so it does not stick, until al dente, about 10 min. Meanwhile, shred the chicken with two forks.
Return the chicken to the pot for 1 min to reheat, then stir in the peas. Fish out the herb stems and sage leaves.
Stir in the lemon juice, season with salt and pepper (how much depends on your broth), and serve topped with parsley.
tips: Orzo keeps drinking broth as it sits; thin leftovers with a splash of broth or water when reheating.
